record.name: Mochi – AI Finance Assistant
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Meet Mochi — your friendly AI money companion.

Mochi helps you manage your personal finances in a simple, smart, and stress-free way. Instead of dealing with complicated spreadsheets or manual tracking, you can record your spending naturally, review your financial habits, and receive helpful insights powered by AI.

Whether you want to track daily expenses, control overspending, build better saving habits, or understand where your money goes each month, Mochi gives you a clear and friendly view of your financial life.

KEY FEATURES

AI Expense Tracking
Quickly record transactions using natural language. Just type something like “Coffee 45k” or “Lunch with friends 120k”, and Mochi helps structure it into amount, category, merchant, and date.

Smart Categorization
Mochi can suggest categories for your transactions, helping you organize spending across food, transport, shopping, bills, entertainment, education, health, and more.

Personal Dashboard
See your monthly spending, income, savings, top categories, recent transactions, and budget progress in one simple dashboard.

Budgets Made Simple
Set spending limits for different categories and track your progress throughout the month. Mochi helps you notice when you are close to your budget.

Saving Goals
Create goals such as travel, emergency fund, new laptop, or future plans. Track your progress and understand how much more you need to save.

AI Financial Insights
Mochi analyzes your spending patterns and gives simple, actionable insights, such as:
• Food spending increased this week
• You are close to your shopping budget
• You are on track with your saving goal
• Your transport spending is higher than usual

AI Chat Assistant
Ask Mochi questions about your money in natural language:
• How much did I spend this month?
• Where did I spend the most?
• Am I overspending on food?
• How much have I saved so far?

Recurring Transactions
Track regular payments such as rent, subscriptions, bills, salary, or monthly transfers.

Import Support
Review and confirm transaction candidates from sources such as SMS, notifications, receipts, or text input where supported.

Privacy-first Design
Your financial data is personal. Mochi is designed to keep your money management experience private, secure, and under your control.

WHY MOCHI?

Most finance apps show numbers. Mochi helps you understand them.

Mochi is designed to feel less like accounting software and more like a helpful companion that supports better financial habits every day.

Use Mochi to:
• Track expenses faster
• Understand spending behavior
• Manage budgets
• Build saving goals
• Get AI-powered insights
• Ask questions about your finances
• Reduce financial stress

Mochi is not a bank, wallet, investment platform, or lending service. Mochi is a personal finance management tool that helps you track, organize, and understand your own financial data.

Start your smarter money journey with Mochi today.

AI RECEIPT & INVOICE SCANNING
Point your camera at any receipt — AI does the rest.

• Understands income, expenses, debts and payments

Chat with your own financial data.

Run the household budget together.

CLOUD BACKUP & SECURITY
Your data stays yours.
• On-device AES-256 encryption and biometric lock (Face ID / fingerprint)

• Automatic daily local backups
• Works offline — online features are optional

• Detailed categories and multiple accounts: cash, bank, credit card
• Debts, receivables, customer & supplier ledgers
• Multi-currency incl. USD, EUR, GBP, TRY and gold (XAU) with live exchange rates

SMART REPORTS & ANALYTICS
• Visual spending charts and category breakdowns
• Monthly & yearly income vs expense comparison
• Savings rate and daily-average statistics
• Export to PDF and Excel

BUDGETS, REMINDERS & AUTOMATION
• Monthly budgets with overspending alerts
• Recurring transactions (salary, rent, bills)
• Payment reminders via notifications

MOTIVATION & GOALS
• Daily streaks and 12 achievement badges
• Set savings goals, track progress — and share goals with family if you like

EASY TO USE
• Clean interface with light & dark themes
• Quick entry, swipe to edit, home-screen widget

PREMIUM
• Unlimited AI receipt scanning, voice input and AI advisor
• Advanced analytics, ad-free experience, priority support

WHO IS IT FOR?
Families managing a shared budget, freelancers, small business owners, students — anyone who wants real control of their money.

7 LANGUAGES
English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Arabic.

record.name: Voice Accountant
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Voice Accountant turns the messiest part of running a small business — tracking every dollar in and out — into a 5-second conversation.

Just say it.
• "Spent $42 at the gas station, paid with my TD debit."
• "Invoice 102 from Acme, $1,200, due next Friday."
• Snap a receipt. Forward a PDF invoice. Drop a voice note while you're driving.

Our AI assistant reads, transcribes, and files every entry into a clean transaction record — categorized, dated, and ready for tax time. You review and confirm. The AI does the typing.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Voice-first chat — record a voice note and let the AI extract the amount, vendor, category, and date.
• Photo receipts — snap a receipt, get a structured transaction with line items and tax.
• Document upload — PDFs, invoices, bank statements, all parsed automatically.
• Records tab — searchable list of every transaction, with trash and restore.
• Reports tab — filter by date range, export to CSV or Excel for your accountant.
• Accountants directory — invite your accountant by email, or find a verified pro.
• Multi-language UI — English, Français, Español, فارسی, with right-to-left support.
• Light, dark, and auto theme.
• Push notifications for new transactions, AI replies, and accountant activity.

BUILT FOR SMALL BUSINESS

• Canadian GIFI codes baked in for tax filing.
• Multi-currency: ISO 4217 currencies including CAD, USD, EUR, GBP, IRR, and more.
• Save your companies, projects, and bank accounts once — the AI auto-links them to new transactions.
• Voice messages and receipts attach to the same record so you have one source of truth at audit time.
• Full CSV / Excel export — your data is yours, always.

PRIVACY & SECURITY

• Chat history is encrypted on your device using iOS Keychain.
• Files are uploaded to a private, per-user folder on AWS S3.
• No ads. No analytics SDK. We do not sell your data.
• Delete your account and all your data any time from inside the app.

Voice Accountant uses AI to draft transaction records. Output is informational only, not professional accounting or tax advice. You are responsible for reviewing and correcting all entries before relying on them.

SUBSCRIPTION

• Free tier: 30 AI chat messages per period, then upgrade for unlimited use.
• Pro: auto-renewing monthly subscription, cancel any time from Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

Got feedback or a feature request? Email moinikamyar@gmail.com — we read every message.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Every invoice app can tell you who owes you money. This one picks up the phone and asks for it.
Invoice Manager Pro now comes with an AI receptionist. It answers the calls you miss while you are on a job, books the work, and when an invoice goes past due it calls the customer, politely, in your name, only when you say go, then tells you exactly what they said.
Still no monthly fee. Still works offline. Still yours on every device.

YOUR AI RECEPTIONIST
• Chases late invoices by phone. It knows who owes what and for how long, because it is reading your ledger, not guessing. You approve who gets called and when.
• Answers the calls you cannot take. Missed calls are missed jobs. It picks up, answers questions about your services and hours, and takes a message you can read later.
• Books the job. New enquiries go straight into your calendar with the customer's details already filled in.
• Identifies itself as an AI, on a recorded line, every time. You get a full transcript, a summary and the outcome of every call.
• You set the tone. Firm with the customer who is 90 days late, gentle with the one who has always paid.

THE REST OF THE BUSINESS, STILL INCLUDED
• Invoices, estimates and quotes, send one in under a minute
• Receipt scanner, snap it and it files itself
• Mileage tracker, GPS logs every trip for you
• Time tracking, bill what you actually worked
• Accounting and tax tools for 15 countries
• Team, payroll and schedules
• Inventory and point of sale
• Projects, reports and analytics
• Chat or talk to your AI assistant about any of it

GET PAID YOUR WAY
Stripe, Square, Apple Pay, PayPal, Venmo, Zelle and bank transfer, straight from the invoice.

NO SUBSCRIPTION FOR THE APP
Invoice Manager Pro is a one-time purchase, with the receptionist as an optional add-on you can switch off any month you do not need it. Unlimited invoices. Unlimited devices. iPhone, iPad and Mac, in sync.

15+ TEMPLATES
Built for construction, medical, legal, creative, consulting and more.

BUILT FOR
• Contractors who are owed money by three people right now
• Freelancers who hate the follow-up email
• Service businesses losing jobs to voicemail
• Anyone who would rather be working than chasing

Zoom Workplace helps you streamline your day and collaborate effortlessly with the power of AI.

Zoom Workplace brings video meetings, chat, phone, appointment scheduler, email, and collaborative documents together in a single app. With Zoom AI built in to help you take notes, summarize, write, and organize, you can get more done without the busy work.*

Power Your Work with AI 
• Capture every conversation: Whether you're hosting or joining, My Notes can automatically take notes during your Zoom Meetings and in-person conversations, so you can stay focused instead of scribbling.
• Catch up instantly: Get automatic meeting summaries and next steps sent to you after the call, so you don’t have to take notes again.
• Ask questions live: Missed something? Ask AI Companion questions like "What did I miss?" or "Was my name mentioned?" during a meeting without interrupting.
• Draft in seconds: Let AI embedded in Zoom Workplace compose emails, chat responses, and whiteboard ideas for you with a simple prompt.
• Summarize threads: Instantly turn long chat threads or SMS conversations into a quick summary so you can get the gist fast.

Seamless Communication
• Connect with anyone: Host or join meetings with crystal-clear video and audio, and work like you're side-by-side with immersive views.
• Stay in sync: Use Zoom Chat to message individuals or groups, organize conversations with channels, and share files instantly.
• Make business calls: Handle calls with Zoom Phone, a robust VoIP solution.*
• Update asynchronously: Record and share Clips—short video messages and screen recordings—to provide updates that your team can watch on their own time.

Next-Gen Collaboration
• Create together: Draft, edit, and collaborate on Docs in real-time, right inside your meetings.
• Brainstorm freely: Use Whiteboard to map out ideas with sticky notes and shapes—or ask AI Companion to generate a mind map for you instantly.
• Share information: Co-edit files and wikis that live right next to your team’s video interface so you never lose context.

Productivity & Organization
• Manage your day: Bring your email and calendar into one unified view to schedule meetings and check messages without switching apps.
• Stop the scheduling ping-pong: Use Zoom Scheduler to share your availability and let others book time slots that work for everyone.*
• Use Zoom AI agentic skills to answer questions like “summarize today's meetings” to instantly connect the dots across your workflows.

record.description_evidence:
Shapes, Inc. is an AI group chat for getting things done with friends. Study together, research a question, plan a trip or work through code with AI and your people in the same room.

A trip you've talked about for months. A deadline nobody wants to mention. An idea that deserves more than “we should”. Bring it to Shapes.

Talk with your friends and AI in the same room. Our AI agents are called Shapes. Pick one you like, or invite a couple with different perspectives. Everyone can ask questions, add context and work on the answer together.

FROM “WE SHOULD” TO “WHO'S DOING WHAT?”
Open the shop. Make the zine. Start the side project. Ask a Shape to break it into steps, then figure out who does what with the people doing it with you.

ONE RABBIT HOLE. WHOLE GROUP INVITED.
Bring the article, the PDF or the question nobody can leave alone. Search the web, compare sources and ask follow-ups without copying answers between five different chats.

EXAM TOMORROW. NOBODY PANIC.
Get a hint when you're stuck on step two. Work through the maths. Ask for a quiz that waits for everyone to answer. Keep asking until it clicks.

THE TRIP MADE IT OUT OF THE CHAT.
Compare places, work out a budget and split the costs. Find a plan your friends can actually say yes to.

SAME BUG. MORE EYES.
Drop in the code, explain what broke and work through a fix with your teammates and a Shape. Ask the follow-up. Check the approach. Get back to building.

PICK YOUR EXTRA BRAINS.
Different Shapes, different personalities. Find one that fits your group. Invite another when you want a second take.

AND YES, YOU CAN STILL JUST HANG OUT.
Make an image. Go off topic. Come back to the project later. It's your chat.

Bring your people. Start something.

record.description_evidence:
[Product Overview]
Mumu Accounting is not just an app that tracks “how much you spent.” It’s more like a personal inventory and finance management system you can build yourself. You can use it solely for bookkeeping, or connect money, items, assets, subscriptions, and relationships—piece by piece.
Mumu doesn’t aim to have “more features is better.” Instead, it lets you keep only what you truly need.

[Core Philosophy | Build-Your-Own Personal Management]
Don’t want subscriptions? Turn it off.
Not tracking items? Hide it.
Just want a simple cash flow record? No problem—extra features disappear.

Modules can be turned on or off, hidden, or reordered. Processes can be simplified or expanded. The app adapts to you, not the other way around.

[Core Modules]
AI Bookkeeping: Supports text, voice, and screenshot parsing for fast, multi-scenario recording.
Automatic Bookkeeping: Combines system capabilities with AI parsing to reduce manual input.
Bill System: Fast recording, templates, installments, refunds, reimbursements, members, tags, combined payments—everything you need.
Personalization: Offers category and theme markets. Modules can be freely enabled or hidden like building blocks, letting you craft a bookkeeping method that fits your habits.
Asset Management: Multi-account management, balance reconciliation, hiding/archiving.
Item Management: Track purchases, usage cycles, and actual costs.
Gold Management: Weight, average price, and profit/loss clearly visible.
Subscription Management: Auto-renewal reminders for long-term expenses.
Fixed Deposits: Record all types of fixed-term funds with clear maturity dates.
Shopping List: Plan purchases to reduce impulsive spending.
Contacts: Keep track of interactions so personal relationships stay clear.
Recurring Bookkeeping: Auto-record loans, subscriptions, and fixed expenses to prevent omissions.
Batch Operations: Supports batch editing, moving, deleting, and property adjustment of bills.
Advanced Search: Filter by date, amount, category, account, contacts, and more.
Anniversary Tracking: Centralized management of important dates to avoid forgetting.
Data Backup: Supports local and multiple backup methods for easy migration and restoration.
Privacy Protection: Password and biometric unlocking, data fully under your control.

[What Mumu Stands For]
Mumu isn’t a product designed once and done. It’s a system built and refined continuously. Useful features stay; unsuitable ones are redesigned. You can gradually build it into the most convenient version for yourself.

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
SparkReceipt is an AI receipt scanner and expense tracker app for freelancers, self-employed professionals, and small business owners. Snap any receipt and SparkReceipt extracts the merchant, amount, date, category and line items in seconds. Connect your inbox, forward email receipts, or upload PDFs and the app handles the rest.

EMAIL INBOX AUTO-SCANNING

Connect Gmail or Outlook and SparkReceipt automatically finds and imports email receipts as they arrive. You stay in control: review, approve, and exclude senders any time.

EMAIL RECEIPT FORWARDING

Prefer to file receipts manually? Forward eReceipts to your personal SparkReceipt address and the AI files them for you.

AI RECEIPT SCANNING (OCR)

The OCR receipt scanner reads paper receipts, PDF invoices, and forwarded email receipts in any language and currency. Smart categorization is based on the products on the receipt, not just the merchant name, so business expenses end up in the right account.

INCOME, EXPENSES, AND PROFIT/LOSS TRACKING

Track income alongside expenses for real-time profit and loss across your business. Tag expenses by client, project, or trip. Convert any currency at accurate historical daily rates for clean tax reporting.

MILEAGE TRACKER

Log business trips and claim every mile at tax time. Start a GPS-tracked drive with one tap or add trips by hand, assign each to a vehicle, client, or project, and SparkReceipt works out the reimbursement. Group trips into a trip report or export your mileage log with your receipts for deduction-ready records.

ACCOUNTING INTEGRATIONS

Push categorized receipts straight into QuickBooks Online, Xero, or Zoho Books, or export reports as PDF, Excel, or CSV when your accountant asks. FreshBooks is in early access. Webhooks and a public API are included.

BANK FEEDS

Connect your bank account and SparkReceipt imports transactions and matches them to your receipts, so missing ones stand out before tax time. Bank feeds are in beta and currently available for US banks. PDF bank statements can be uploaded too.

SHARE WITH YOUR ACCOUNTANT

Invite your accountant directly into SparkReceipt or share a secure link. No more emailing receipts as attachments. Set time limits to auto-hide shared receipts after tax season.

TEAM COLLABORATION

Invite teammates and keep everyone's receipts and expenses organized in one secure place. Sort by category, tag, or user, and approve expense reports together.

CLOUD STORAGE THAT WORKS EVERYWHERE

Documents are encrypted and backed up in the cloud. Access them from iPhone, iPad, or any browser via the SparkReceipt web app at no extra cost.

SPARKAGENT AI ASSISTANT

Ask SparkAgent about your spending, or have it categorize new expenses and tag last month's travel receipts. It asks before anything that can't be undone.

KEY FEATURES

- AI receipt scanner with automatic data extraction (OCR)
- Email inbox auto-scanning for Gmail, Outlook and IMAP
- Smart categorization based on products on the receipt
- Income and expense tracking in any currency
- Real-time profit and loss reports
- GPS mileage tracker with automatic reimbursement
- QuickBooks Online, Xero, and Zoho Books integrations
- SparkAgent AI assistant for questions and bulk edits
- Search by merchant, amount, tag, or text inside the image
- PDF, Excel, and CSV exports for accountants
- Bank feeds (beta) for US banks with automatic receipt matching
- No ads
- Bank-level security and encryption

WHO USES SPARKRECEIPT

Freelancers tracking project expenses. Self-employed consultants managing multiple income streams. Real estate investors tracking property costs. Small business owners preparing for tax season. Accountants who want their clients to send tidy, categorized receipts instead of shoeboxes.

Every receipt is captured the day you get it and ready for your accountant in one export.

record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Why do 15.8M members love SoFi? Bank, invest, and own crypto all in one app, now with SoFi Coach, your free AI-driven financial guide.

NEW! SOFI COACH: AI-DRIVEN FINANCIAL GUIDE
• Chat with Coach for personalized financial insights, powered by SoFi Financial Planners.
• AI-driven analysis of your spending, budget, credit score, debt, and investment portfolio.

ONLINE BANKING
• Open a bank account with no account, service, or maintenance fees and no minimum balance required.
• Mobile banking app to send money, transfer funds, pay bills, and manage your finances.

HIGH-YIELD SAVINGS ACCOUNT
• Savings Vaults help you organize your emergency fund and savings goals in one place.
• Instant transfers between checking and savings with no fees.

BUY, SELL & HOLD CRYPTO
• First national chartered bank where individuals can buy, sell, and hold cryptocurrency.
• Access Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, plus 25+ cryptocurrencies on a platform with the safeguards of a bank.

SOFI PLUS PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP
• 4.50% APY on up to $20,000 in savings with a SoFi Plus membership.¹

STOCK TRADING & INVESTING
• Trade stocks and ETFs through SoFi Securities to build your investment portfolio (other fees apply).
• Invest in fractional shares from $5, or explore index funds, ETFs, and options trading (restrictions apply).
• Automated investing, IRA and Roth IRA retirement accounts, and portfolio management through SoFi Wealth.

BUDGET APP & MONEY MANAGEMENT
• Budget app to track spending, set savings goals, and manage your finances from one place.
• Track expenses, monitor your net worth, and manage money across SoFi and linked accounts.

LOANS & CREDIT SCORE
• Personal loans and student loan refinancing for debt consolidation and large purchases. Pre-qualify in minutes without affecting your credit score.
• Credit score monitoring, credit report access, and credit-building tools.

For disclosures on SoFi Invest platforms visit SoFi.com/legal. For a full listing of the fees associated with SoFi Invest please view our fee schedule (https://www.sofi.com/wealth/assets/documents/sofi-invest-fee-schedule.pdf).

When you open a SoFi Savings Account, SoFi Bank will also automatically open a SoFi Checking Account in your name. See the SoFi Bank Deposit Account Agreement for details.

We do not charge any account, service, or maintenance fees for SoFi Checking and Savings. We do charge transaction fees for outgoing wire transfers, Instant Transfers, and global remittance transfers. Our fee policy is subject to change at any time. See the SoFi Bank Fee Sheet for details at sofi.com/legal/banking-fees/.

Estimated annual interest earnings are based on a $20,000 SoFi Bank savings account balance and assumes 3.10% APY, with interest compounded monthly and no additional deposits or withdrawals. It also assumes that you receive eligible direct deposit or $5,000 in qualifying deposits every 31 days for the entire 12 months. Rates are variable and subject to change, and actual interest earned may vary based on changes to your account balance and applicable APY. Interest earned on a traditional bank account based on a $20,000 savings balance and FDIC savings rate of 0.38%, referenced July 20, 2026.

This estimate is for informational purposes only and should not be relied on as a guarantee of future interest earnings. For your most current APY details, see the APY Details page in the SoFi mobile app. See also sofi.com/legal/banking-rate-sheet.

SoFi will match 1% of a customer's ACAT transfers, up to $5,000,000 into an existing or newly opened SoFi self-directed individual retirement account (IRA) or SoFi self-directed taxable account during the Offer Period of Sept 10- Sept 30, 2026. The transferred assets must be settled before the end of the Offer Period to qualify for the match and must be maintained in the account for five years. For the full terms and conditions, please visit SoFi.com/ACATterms.

record.description_evidence:
Introducing RCPT – Your Ultimate Bookkeeping Solution

RCPT isn’t just an expense tracker—it’s a complete bookkeeping platform engineered to simplify every facet of your financial management. Whether you're a freelancer, a small business owner, or managing personal finances, RCPT provides an integrated, all-in-one solution to handle your day-to-day bookkeeping with ease and precision.

Key Features:

Comprehensive Expense Tracking & Receipt Storage: Easily log and categorize every expense—from daily purchases to business investments—and securely store digital copies of your receipts for quick retrieval and streamlined record keeping.
Seamless Transaction Sync: Automatically synchronize transactions from all your bank accounts and financial platforms, ensuring that your records are always current and accurate.
Integrated Work Log: Capture daily activities, projects, and client interactions in a dedicated work log, making time tracking and billing straightforward and transparent.
Advanced Analytics & Insights: Dive deep into your financial data with intuitive charts and reports that reveal spending patterns and profit trends, empowering you to make informed decisions.
Smart Automation: Streamline your bookkeeping tasks with automated workflows that handle repetitive processes like data entry and report generation, freeing you up to focus on growing your business.
Secure & Private: With robust security measures in place, your financial data remains safe and confidential, giving you peace of mind as you manage your money.
Experience the power of a full-scale bookkeeping system that evolves with your needs. With RCPT, transform your financial management into a streamlined, automated, and insightful process—designed for today’s fast-paced business world.
